facts.value: Undergraduate degree-seeking students who previously attended ASU but have not been enrolled for up to seven consecutive fall or spring semesters may be eligible to return through Quick Re-entry.
Students do not need to submit a new application or application fee.
Students may sign in to My ASU and register for classes.
Students may have a hold or Priority Task that needs to be completed before they are able to register for classes.
The catalog year upon re-entry will be determined via current policy.
International students are responsible for all SEVIS requirements.
International students eligible for quick re-entry should contact ASU's International Students and Scholars Center at [email protected]
International students should submit documentation for issuance of an I-20 for visa purposes.

Students whose absence is due to military deployment, service on an official church mission, or with a foreign aid service of the federal government, or a permanent disability should submit a Leave of Absence.
Students must submit official transcript(s) from all institutions attended during absence from ASU.
Official transcripts must be mailed or sent electronically directly to Admission Services by the records office of the issuing institutions.
ASU does not accept transcripts sent or carried by hand by applicants themselves or transmitted by fax.
